s1.desc: a bedroom drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: One shot, but a slow steady zoom in from the first frame to the last: feature-matched scale 1.015 over f0-21, 1.031-1.035 per 45 frames, 1.141 over f0-178 (compare 0/178 shows every bed and curtain edge doubled). v4 called it static. Content: Polly lies on the bed under the duvet while Pax leans over the headboard side, hops down, rolls the duvet around Polly into a burrito, climbs back up and cuddles her with a heart. Kept out per D3; a candidate for a tagged camera-move group if one is ever made.
